name: aimart-parquet
title: AImart Parquet: messy files to Parquet + SQL
description: Converts messy CSV/TSV, JSON/NDJSON, Excel (xlsx, xls, ods), SPSS, Stata, SAS files and tables in digital PDFs into clean, typed Parquet, with a schema report, and answers a read-only DuckDB SQL query over each file. Pay per file converted and per query.
